evidence.r1: Glass only on the nav bar, the date switcher, Tickets and the Tickets popover; all controls.
evidence.r2: The black 'Thu 18' pill and the selected 'Single ticket' row are fills, not stacked glass.
evidence.r3: Three bars (nav, dates, Tickets), each load-bearing.
evidence.r4: Nav, dates and popover share one regular material; Tickets is the same material with a tint.
evidence.r5: No clear variant; the bars frost the snowy street still.
evidence.r6: Only Tickets, the primary action, is tinted: red on the background, white label.
evidence.r7: The bars show the still through a blur, and Tickets is tinted glass, not a flat fill.
evidence.r8: Capsule bars and button; a fixed-radius popover.
evidence.r9: The 'Thu 18' pill is concentric in the date capsule; the ticket rows sit inset below the popover header, with no pinched corner.
evidence.r10: The floating nav, dates and Tickets are capsules.
evidence.r11: The top bar holds three groups: nav links, dates, Tickets.
evidence.r12: The Tickets popover puts an '×' icon button on the same glass as the text ticket rows (menu, both schemes).
evidence.r13: Material sits on each bar and on the popover, not on the links inside.
evidence.r14: The nav and date bars are deliberately separate pills of one material; Tickets stands apart at the right.
evidence.r15: Scroll tiles 2 and 3 show one soft fade band at the top, where content dissolves into the fixed still under the bars; none elsewhere.
evidence.r16: The fade band keeps the still behind the bars at every scroll position (tiles 2 and 3, both schemes).
evidence.r17: At rest the title panel and schedule sit clear of the bars; only the still is beneath them.
evidence.r18: Light: dark labels on pale glass exceed 14:1. Dark: white nav labels ~5.5:1, dark date labels and popover rows ~5:1.
evidence.r19: Reduced capture: the bars go opaque white with legible labels, and Tickets keeps its tint. Contrast and motion were not captured.
evidence.r20: On the first screen the still runs to the window edges, with the bars floating over it.
evidence.r21: At scroll 900 the 'Programme' heading sits clear below the bars; there is no sidebar.
evidence.r22: No scrim or border under the bars; the top fade is the edge effect.
evidence.r23: The Tickets popover opens in place of the Tickets button, and a pointer glow shows in the dark popover.
evidence.r24: Nav and date labels are monochrome; the only colour is the primary tint on Tickets.
evidence.r25: Labels read against their glass over the snow in both schemes; none matches the backdrop.
